title: Explicit negation: legacy v1 API is NOT supported anymore
notes: Tests meaning-reversal resistance on a decommission announcement — the transcript names the v1 API only to state it is no longer supported. An extractor that drops the negation and records 'v1 is supported' inverts the fact entirely.

turns.text: Just confirming: we do NOT support the legacy v1 API anymore — it was fully decommissioned last quarter.
Understood, v1 is gone. Is v2 the only supported surface now?
Yes, v2 only. Anyone still hitting v1 endpoints gets a 410 Gone.
Noted — v1 decommissioned, 410 Gone on any v1 hit, v2 is the sole supported API.

gold_atoms.text: The legacy v1 API is NOT supported anymore — it was decommissioned last quarter.
Requests to v1 endpoints now return HTTP 410 Gone.
v2 is the only currently-supported API surface.

forbidden_items: The v1 API is still supported
